sentences.text: Against the said award, a reference was made under Section 64 of the Act 2013 which was allowed.
Being aggrieved by the aforesaid, the respondents filed First Appeal No. 142/2022 and First Appeal No. 147/2022 which was dismissed by order dated 06.02.2023.

The Executing Court has stayed the execution of the award only on filing of an application by the respondents that they have preferred SLP against the order of the High Court before the Apex Court and the case has been fixed on 11.05.2023 and thereafter the next date is 20.06.2023.
It is submitted that there is no stay order passed by the Apex Court and, therefore, the Executing Court could not have stayed the execution of warrant of attachment.

3) Counsel for the respondent/State submits that the SLP could not be listed and heard because of summer vacation in the Supreme Court and, therefore, a date may be given/fixed before the trial Court after 10.07.2023.
4) After hearing learned counsel for the parties, the petition is disposed off with a direction that the matter will be taken up by the Executing Court on 17.07.2023.
On the said date the respondents shall file copy of the stay order passed by the Apex Court, if any otherwise the Executing Court shall proceed for execution of the warrant of attachment.
5) With the aforesaid, the writ petition is disposed off.

opennyai_summary.facts:
The present petition is filed under Article 227 of the Constitution of India being aggrieved by the order dated 09.05.2023 passed by the Executing Court whereby the warrant of attachment has been stayed.
2) Counsel for the petitioner submits that in favour of the petitioner an award under Section 63 of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 has been passed.
Against the said award, a reference was made under Section 64 of the Act 2013 which was allowed.
Being aggrieved by the aforesaid, the respondents filed First Appeal No. 142/2022 and First Appeal No. 147/2022 which was dismissed by order dated 06.02.2023.
The Executing Court has stayed the execution of the award only on filing of an application by the respondents that they have preferred SLP against the order of the High Court before the Apex Court and the case has been fixed on 11.05.2023 and thereafter the next date is 20.06.2023.

On the said date the respondents shall file copy of the stay order passed by the Apex Court, if any otherwise the Executing Court shall proceed for execution of the warrant of attachment.
